about_this_file: The whole team on one invented mailbox: a Principal Engineer leading an AI-RAN part in a Beyond 5G research group at a Bangalore R&D centre. The mailbox is the mail in mail_cases_b5g.json plus the extras below. Each case is what the person types, one message after another, with what should be true afterwards. Checks are read by team_eval.py's generic grader. Dates like {day+2} and {iso+2} are relative to the day it runs. No real person, address or message.

profile.name: Ananya Krishnan
profile.role: Principal Engineer and Part Leader, AI-RAN, Beyond 5G Research Group
profile.vips: Vikram Desai is my Group Head and my manager. Dr. Suresh Menon is VP and head of the Advanced Communications Lab. Dr. Jae-won Park leads 6G research at Seoul HQ. Min-ji Lee runs 3GPP standards planning in Suwon. Rohit Bansal is the NTN tech lead in my part; Farah Siddiqui and Deepak Joshi are engineers in my part.
profile.about: I lead the AI-RAN part: AI/ML for the air interface, beam management and CSI compression, our operator field trial, and our RAN1 contributions.
